column1: # 超级马力欧 3D 世界 + 狂怒世界（Switch，基础版 v0 + 更新 1.2.2 = v262144）的游戏档案。移植中：Mac 上 3D 世界进到 1-1，狂怒世界进到开放世界
# Game profile of Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.2.2 = v262144). In bring-up: on the Mac 3D World reaches World 1-1 and Bowser's Fury its open world
# 格式见 dm/games/README.md | Format: see dm/games/README.md
# 任天堂 EPD 引擎（sead / agl，NintendoWare G3d / Ui2d / Vfx / Atk），SDK 10.4.0，NVN；RomFS 几乎全是 Yaz0 压缩的 SARC（.szs）。
# 着色器：ShaderData/*.szs 里的 bfsha（BNSH）与 agl sharcb（BAHS），EffectData 的粒子特效（BNSH），少数 LayoutData 布局（BNSH），SystemData/AglResource.szs（BAHS）
# Nintendo EPD's engine (sead / agl, NintendoWare G3d / Ui2d / Vfx / Atk), SDK 10.4.0, NVN; RomFS is almost entirely Yaz0-compressed SARC archives (.szs).
# Shaders: bfsha (BNSH) and agl sharcb (BAHS) in ShaderData/*.szs, particle effects in EffectData (BNSH), a few layouts in LayoutData (BNSH), SystemData/AglResource.szs (BAHS)
# 游戏名：只给档案列表与 Mac 窗口标题当标签；iOS App 名取基础版 NSP 里的游戏名，包名按基础版标题号（build_ipa.sh / NSP 脚本）

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# 虚拟手柄首次用 3D 布局（十字键、右摇杆、L3 / R3）：右摇杆转视角 | the virtual gamepad starts in the 3D layout (D-pad, right stick, L3 / R3): the right stick turns the camera
# 只解了合并 1.2.2 的那份；基础版单独的构建号用到时再补 | only the merged 1.2.2 copy is extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed

# 共享字体记作类型 0、不调 Decode，地址原样交给 ScalableFontEngine::LoadFont：地址处要直接是 TTF（main+0x975658）| shared fonts are recorded as type 0, no Decode, and the address goes as is to ScalableFontEngine::LoadFont: it must point at the TTF itself (main+0x975658)
# NPDM 不声明系统资源（META +0x14 = 0）：走 SetHeapSize。main 的 bss 只有约 7 MB。先用十三机兵防卫圈的分区（块 4 GB = 前置 256 MB + 别名区 256 MB + 栈区 256 MB + 堆区 3.25 GB），实测后再定

# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. main's bss is only about 7 MB. Starts from 13 Sentinels' partition (4 GB block = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region) until measured
# 游戏核对 NVN API 版本：主版本 == 53、次版本 ≥ 313（main+0x711c88），否则不建设备 | the game checks the NVN API version: major == 53 and minor >= 313 (main+0x711c88), else it creates no device
# ---- NVN 驱动常量段（dmsh_build.py 出包、nvn_mtl.m 运行时现填） | NVN driver constant segments (dmsh_build.py at packaging, nvn_mtl.m filled at run time) ----
# 先沿用马力欧的，按全库着色器实测后再定 | Mario's values until measured over all shaders
